summary: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with High West Partners LLC for an at-the-money equity line of credit up to $30 million. The company may sell ordinary shares at a discount to VWAP (85-97%) at its sole discretion, with proceeds for general corporate purposes. There is no fixed price, premium, or binding commitment to sell; it is a conventional stand-by equity facility. No special-situation trigger exists.
